page.overview:
Who is Alligator General?

Alligator General belongs to Journey to the West. The is an attendant of Ao Guang, the Dragon King of the East Sea.

When Sun Wukong demanded a new set of clothing from Ao Guang, he had the Alligator General ring the bronze bell to summon the other three Dragon Kings.

In Journey to the West, Alligator General sits among related figures, places, and turning points that give the entry its encyclopedia trail.
